description: This Council is asked for its observations on an application submitted to Westminster City Council (25/08486/FULL) for: Demolition of the existing buildings and redevelopment of the site to create a Sui Generis Clinical Life Sciences medical discovery hub including provision for clinical trials, plus retail/restaurant/caf‚/gym uses (Class E(a), (b), (d) and (g)), a multifunctional community and learning space (Class F2), basement plant, landscaping, cycle parking facilities and installation of roof top plant and all other works incidental to the proposals.(For consultation purposes: the application is an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) development and is accompanied by an Environmental Statement (ES), which may be viewed with the planning application documents)
site_name: Former Imperial College Medical School, Praed Street, London, W2 1NY
